title: Electrical Talent Acquisition Manager — Covington, Georgia
location_policy: Metro Atlanta first; Southeast discovery allowed for C if seeking work or willing to relocate. No nationwide search.

geographic_scope.out_of_area_exception: Southeast candidates seeking work or generally willing to relocate
geographic_scope.origin_restriction: Georgia, Alabama, Florida, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina

tracks.qualification_note: Both electrical field and recruiting/HR experience required.

compensation.flexibility: Some flexibility above $70,000; no higher ceiling specified. Record expectations for employer review rather than automatically excluding above-target prospects.

start_basis: User explicitly confirmed immediate start during profile refinement.
travel_pay_basis: Carried forward from prior user instructions; no travel allowance specified in the posting.
relocation: Relocation assistance available; Southeast candidates may express general willingness to relocate. Verify willingness to work in Covington.
required_evidence: Hands-on electrical field employment AND subsequent recruiting or HR experience
Ability to interview electrical candidates, assess demonstrated field skills and recommend appropriate pay; verify through interview/work sample

preferred_experience.note: Both electrical field and recruiting/HR experience are now mandatory. Do not infer field experience from recruiting electricians. No mandatory degree or license added.

responsibilities: Recruit electricians, foremen and other skilled field roles through the full hiring process
Source through job boards, referrals, social media, trade schools and industry relationships
Conduct phone and in-person interviews and assess field capability before presentation to leadership
Plan for current and upcoming project manpower needs
Maintain a qualified pipeline and local electrical/skilled-trades relationships
Develop recruiting strategies, coordinate offers and support new-hire transitions
Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate communication
Track recruiting activity, hiring outcomes and effective sources

ab_requires: Both electrical field and recruiting/HR experience
Confirmed candidate-specific job-seeking signal within last 30 days
readiness_to_record_separately: Salary expectations against a $70,000 target with some flexibility; higher expectations require employer review
In-person Covington commute or supported relocation
Earliest start date relative to immediate need
signal_exclusions: A recruiter advertising vacancies or sourcing candidates is not evidence that the recruiter wants a job
Employer hiring ads, staffing-agency sales pitches and recruiter service advertisements
Undated Open To Work headlines and old resumes without a recent original statement
Index refresh, retrieval, publication metadata or a third-party like used as the candidate's signal date
A matching name alone used to merge identities or corroborate availability

activation.note: Dual-experience public-index discovery. No LinkedIn login access and no model calls.

research_constraints.budget_policy: User authorized up to $20 for this single 30-minute batch; preserve cumulative ledger, $100 POC ceiling and lower aggregate/provider safeguards. No automatic follow-on run.

grading.A: Local dual-experience fit, recent personal job-seeking evidence, stronger technical interviewing/pay-assessment evidence
grading.B: Local dual-experience fit and recent personal job-seeking evidence; interviewing/pay-assessment detail still needs review
grading.C: Southeast dual-experience prospect seeking work or willing to relocate; general relocation statement accepted
grading.D: Metro Atlanta dual-experience fit without confirmed recent personal job-seeking evidence
grading.automated_grades: Proposed review groups only. No automatic A/B verification.
